**Answer.** The FliteTest X-Wing model is assembled using two asymmetric flat-plate wings rolled at [20]{.key} and [-20]{.key} degrees to represent the cross-lapped slots. Cosmetic engines and guns are modelled as cylindrical fuselages positioned visually based on the plan. The assembled model is visualised in (@fig-three-view).
